# Step - drop_query

`drop_query` · category: [Saved queries](../../traversal/step_reference.md#saved-queries)

Removes a saved query; false when there is none.

## Forms

```text
drop_query(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
{ g.define_query(#{name: "n", body: "fn n() { 1 }"}); g.drop_query("n") }   // true
```
